FAQs

Roofing Questions, Answered

What people ask before they ring, answered by the team.

About Us The Work Where We Work Getting a Quote

About Us

Who runs Sandon Roofing?

Frisco Finney runs it, with a team of 9. More about us.

How long have you been in business?

Sandon Roofing has 15 years in business.

What qualifications does the team hold?

Between us we hold City and Guilds, health and safety, first aid, manual handling and construction qualifications.

Do you offer a guarantee?

Yes, we offer a 10 year guarantee. Ask us what it covers on your job when we quote.

The Work

What roofing work do you do?

New roofs, roof repairs, flat roofing, guttering, chimney repairs, and fascias, soffits and dry verge.

How long does a new roof take?

A typical job takes us around 4 to 5 days to complete. See our new roofs.

Can you re-roof quickly in an emergency?

Yes. If it is an emergency, we can have a roof stripped, felted and battened with new tiles in 2 days.

What do you replace an old felt flat roof with?

The flat roofs in our photos had their worn felt stripped off, a new timber deck boarded out and a rubber membrane laid over it. Our flat roofing.

Do you fit dry verge?

Yes. Dry verge is one of our services, along with fascia and soffit boards. Fascias, soffits and dry verge.

Do you do anything apart from roofing?

We also take on outside decorating and painting, fencing and power washing.

Where We Work

Which areas do you cover?

Stafford, Lichfield, Tamworth, Cannock, Stoke-on-Trent and the areas around them. See the areas we cover.

Do you cover the villages around Stafford?

Yes, including Stone, Penkridge, Eccleshall, Gnosall, Bradley and Sandon. Just outside them? Call and ask.

Getting a Quote

How do I get a quote?

Call 07478 904491, message us on WhatsApp, or fill in the form on our contact page, which opens WhatsApp with your details ready to send.

What should I tell you when I get in touch?

What needs doing, your town or postcode, and a photo of the problem if you can take one safely from the ground.

Still Got a Question?

Ask the team directly, by phone or on WhatsApp.
